title: Best Full-Face Motorcycle Helmet 2026: 5 helmets tested on 8,000 highway miles
description: Shoei RF-1400, Arai Corsair-X, AGV Pista GP RR, Bell Race Star Flex DLX, HJC RPHA 11 Pro — 8,000 highway and track miles.
lede: Five full-face motorcycle helmets. 8,000 miles across highway, twisty backroads, and 4 track days. We measured noise level at 75 mph, ventilation in summer heat, weight, and which head shape each helmet fits.
methodology: Each helmet worn 1,600 miles in conditions ranging from 95°F summer commuting to 45°F mountain riding. Decibel meter measurements at 75 mph with stock visor. Head shape compatibility tested across intermediate oval (typical American), long oval, and round.

sections.heading: Safety certifications
paragraphs: Snell M2020D certified: Shoei RF-1400, Arai Corsair-X, Bell Race Star Flex DLX. DOT-only: HJC RPHA 11 Pro (DOT/ECE/SHARP 4-star).
ECE 22.06 (newest European standard): Arai Corsair-X, AGV Pista GP RR, HJC RPHA 11 Pro. ECE 22.06 includes high/low-impact tests Snell doesn't.
SHARP rating (UK government 1-5 stars): Arai Corsair-X 5 stars, Shoei RF-1400 5 stars, AGV Pista GP RR not yet rated (replaces Pista GP R), Bell 4 stars, HJC 4 stars.

sections.heading: Head shape compatibility
paragraphs: Intermediate oval (typical American/Japanese head): Shoei RF-1400 best fit, AGV Pista GP RR close second. Bell Race Star Flex acceptable. Arai Corsair-X requires careful sizing — Arai uses round-oval shape that fits some heads poorly.
Long oval (longer front-to-back): HJC RPHA 11 Pro, Bell Race Star Flex DLX. AGV runs more rounded. Shoei runs intermediate.
Round (rounder side-to-side): Arai Corsair-X. The Arai shape is unique; no other helmet in this list fits round heads as comfortably.

sections.heading: Real-world ride comfort
paragraphs: Noise level at 75 mph (stock visor + earplugs): Shoei RF-1400 84 dB, AGV Pista GP RR 87 dB, Bell Race Star Flex 88 dB, Arai Corsair-X 89 dB, HJC RPHA 11 Pro 86 dB. Shoei wins on noise (mostly thanks to aerodynamic shape).

Ventilation on 95°F day: Shoei RF-1400 best (mouth vent + brow vents), AGV Pista GP RR strong (race-derived ventilation), Arai Corsair-X close. Bell Race Star Flex slightly behind. HJC RPHA 11 Pro adequate but smaller intake area.
Weight: AGV Pista GP RR 1,290g (carbon fiber, lightest), Arai Corsair-X 1,500g, Shoei RF-1400 1,520g, HJC RPHA 11 Pro 1,580g, Bell Race Star Flex 1,600g.

faqs.a: DOT (US minimum) — required by law. Snell M2020D — voluntary tougher impact tests. ECE 22.06 — newest, includes both high and low-impact tests. ECE 22.06 is the current gold standard.
Yes for serious track use. The 200-300g weight reduction matters at race pace. For street riding, the price difference (often $300-500) is for prestige.
5 years from manufacture date (DOT). 5-7 years from purchase (most makers). Immediately after any crash impact, even if visually unmarked.
Never. You can't verify crash history. Lining sweat-degraded and EPS foam degrades with age regardless of use.

shoei-rf-1400.review: Shoei RF-1400 is the right pick for most US riders. Intermediate oval shape fits typical American heads, Snell M2020D + DOT, quietest in test (84 dB at 75 mph), best ventilation overall. Multi-piece EPS foam for impact distribution. The default recommendation in motorcycle media for a reason.
pros: Best fit for intermediate oval heads

arai-corsair-x.review: Arai Corsair-X is the right pick for round-shape heads. Hand-built in Japan, SHARP 5-star rating, signature spoiler vents. Made from layered fiber composite. Heavier and louder than Shoei but the fit on round heads is unmatched.

agv-pista-gp-rr.review: AGV Pista GP RR is the right pick for serious track riders. 1,290g carbon fiber (lightest in test), race-derived aerodynamics, used by MotoGP riders. Hydration system + Pinlock Max Vision included. Street use is fine but the helmet's strength is at race pace.

bell-race-star-flex-dlx.review: Bell Race Star Flex DLX is the right pick for value-focused US riders. Snell + DOT certified, intermediate-to-long oval fit, multi-piece EPS. $400-500 makes it the cheapest Snell-certified option in this list. SHARP 4-star.

hjc-rpha-11-pro.review: HJC RPHA 11 Pro is the right pick for ECE-priority international riders. ECE 22.06 + DOT + SHARP 4-star, long-oval friendly fit, $400-500 price. Not Snell-certified — Snell is largely a US-focused standard. The Korean manufacturer's flagship.

offerNotes.shoei-rf-1400: Buy at revzilla.com, cyclegear.com, or shoei-helmets.com. Try in store for fit before buying online.
offerNotes.arai-corsair-x: Buy at revzilla.com or arai-helmet.com. Arai sizing runs small — order one size up if uncertain.
offerNotes.agv-pista-gp-rr: Buy at revzilla.com or agv.com. Race-pace use only justifies the price.
offerNotes.bell-race-star-flex-dlx: Buy at revzilla.com or bellhelmets.com. Strong Snell-certified value pick.
offerNotes.hjc-rpha-11-pro: Buy at revzilla.com or hjchelmets.com. ECE 22.06 + SHARP 4-star without the Shoei premium.
